title: Japanese Salad with Rice Noodles, Tofu, Cucumber and Wakame
subtitle: with a sesame rice vinegar dressing
description: Thin rice noodles are topped with marinated cucumber, wakame seaweed and soy-sesame tofu cubes, all dressed in a sweet and tangy rice vinegar and mirin dressing.

steps.text: Place the diced tofu in a bowl, pour over 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 teaspoon sesame oil, mix gently by hand and set aside.
Place the noodles in a large bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave for a few minutes (per the packet instructions) until completely soft. Drain, squeeze out and set aside.
Place the wakame in another bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave until softened, drain well, massage with your hands (the green colour deepens) and set aside.
In a small bowl mix the rice vinegar, brown sugar, mirin, 1 teaspoon soy sauce and 2 teaspoons sesame oil.
Trim the ends of the cucumbers and slice thinly. Toss them in a large bowl with half the dressing, then add the wakame and mix again.

To serve, place the noodles in a serving bowl as a base and pour over the remaining dressing. Top with the wakame and cucumbers, make a hollow in the centre and add the tofu. Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
